text:
deploybot: initiating staged rollout v2026-05-11-rc2 -> 10% eu-central at 13:14 UTC. sentinels: p95, 5xx, mem. status: IN_PROGRESS
anita: spotted p95 tail spike in eu-central within 90s (200ms -> 480ms). no broad 5xx yet.
marc: digging - traces show memory thrash on quant-decoder path under long-sequence inputs. suspect model variant q4b-hotpath.
seth: which pool? can we keep the rollout at 10% and not advance until infra confirms?
lydia: ops note: I'll start host checks. ETA 2m. prefer pause if OOM traces present.
infra-bot: quickvote initiated: pause rollout? react :+1: pause, :-1: continue.
anita: +1 pause. i can rerun a small reproducer against the canary instance.
marc: +1 pause. also recommend pin region to last-stable to avoid cascading cache pressure.
seth: +1 pause - long seqs hurt this quant path. want to avoid a partial-sla blip for eu customers.
deploybot: health snapshot: p95 +140%, 5xx 0.2% (baseline 0.12%). awaiting consensus.
infra-bot: votes: 4 pause, 0 continue. executing pause and routing pin now.
deploybot: action=paused; draining canary in eu-central and pinning eu-central to v2026-05-01-stable. canary traffic 10% -> 0%.
deploybot: audit log updated: reason="quant-decoder memory thrash on long sequences causing p95 tail"; ticket placeholder=REL-1355.
infra-bot: infra findings: one worker showed gpu memory allocation spikes and subsequent process recycle. increased quant-fallback threshold and bumped k8s memory request on that daemonset.
anita: running targeted eval (1k long prompts) against rc2 replica to confirm mitigation.
marc: I'll prepare a small patch to fallback to q4b-safe for sequences >512 tokens; could be a quick config change if approved.
seth: sounds good. please also draft a concise customer-facing release note line: "Canary paused in eu-central for rc2 due to memory pressure on long sequence workloads; draining to stable and investigating (REL-1355)."
lydia: created REL-1355 and added infra+ml owners. priority=P1.
infra-bot: timeline: pause @+70s, worker recycle @+3m, config bump @+5m, drain complete @+6m. health trending down toward baseline.
anita: early repro: rc2 still shows intermittent p95 spikes when cache fill >90% even after bump. attaching lightweight traces to ticket.
marc: ok, i'll push a safe-fallback config to a canary replica and we can consider a very slow re-roll to 5% for smoke.
seth: prefer to keep blocked until fallback is validated. schedule a short reconvene in 30m to review load results.
lydia: adding a quiet window to the amended rollout plan and outlining rollback gates (any p95 > +50% or 5xx > baseline*2 triggers immediate rollback).
deploybot: recorded rollout note and paused state. keep replies in-thread for updates.
infra-bot: postmortem placeholder PM-REL-1355 created.
anita: will post results of the 1k-run here when complete.
marc: thanks everyone. good catch early.
(automated) deploybot: final audit entry: action=paused; rollout=v2026-05-11-rc2; region=eu-central; ticket=REL-1355; note="memory thrash on quant-decoder for long sequences -> paused and pinned"
